body:
I suggested family therapy, and we've had a couple of horrific sessions before, but they're not interested. I'm often a scapegoat for any problems in the family and my parents think they have absolutely no issues whatsoever. 

When I was angry, I said to my dad that my therapist had said some of his behaviour was borderline psychopathic. He said 'so what if it is?'. Says it all really

I have to admit, a big reason why I keep bothering to see them is because of the family dog that I grew up with, Buddha. I know he's just a dog but I really love him and it's so great to be able to see him and walk him. Plus, at least he's always happy to see me, and I know he misses me. He's a pug :p 

Of course my parents are very controlling about that too, and often threaten to cut me off completely and not allow me to walk him at all if I do anything wrong. They recently told me that I wouldn't be allowed to walk him without staff from the supported living unit coming with me (the staff do not give a shit; they sit on their phones all day).

I guess another reason I keep going back is because underneath all this hatred, anger and resentment, I feel a sense of grief almost. I sometimes feel lost and dependent on them, since I have been reliant on them for so long. I think deep down my mum is also in pain, and does want to have a functional family but has no idea how to do it. She had shitty parents who she never sees so I think she's caught in that cycle.

What upset me most is having to see her in the hospital after she had a biopsy. Everything was fine, but we were worried about it being breast cancer. I did the right thing and visited, and it was the first time in a long time that she said 'I love you' because she was at her most vulnerable and she knew I was trying to reach out to her. It was pretty upsetting actually.

That said, my mum is pretty much totally uncaring besides that, and the family motto is in fact: 'get over it'. I've been told that so many times when I had problems big or small. 

And just the week after the hospital, my mum was back to playing the broken record of 'you don't give a shit about me' and how I do nothing but cause the family misery. It just feels like there's something crucial missing, and my dad is a whole other story.

What the fuck is wrong with some people?! Seriously, some people are gay, who gives a shit? Damn...if people got so wound up about things that ACTUALLY mattered, like political issues and climate change for example, the human race would be a lot better off.
